# Overview

This file reads the two annotated workbooks independently, attaches **one cluster assignment per participant from the corresponding experiment × condition cluster CSV**, and conducts **separate** analyses for six groups:

1. Experiment 1 — Curvature instruction
2. Experiment 1 — No instruction
3. Experiment 2 — Curvature instruction
4. Experiment 2 — No instruction
5. Experiment 3 — Curvature instruction
6. Experiment 3 — No instruction

For each group across Experiments 1, 2, and 3, **human and LLM coding are shown separately** and compared. The feature-mention analysis includes the coded indicators (including Size and the animal-like indicator for Experiments 2 and 3). **Priority 1–3** and **notes** are reserved for later analyses. Missing indicator codes are preserved as `NA`, not recoded as zero.

**File placement:** Put this `.Rmd`, the human Excel workbook (`Curvature Open Answers.xlsx`), and the LLM Excel workbook (`Curvature_Open_Answers_LLM_coded_detailed.xlsx`) in `Open_Answers/`. Leave the six `participant_cluster_lookup.csv` files where the main analyses exported them. This `.Rmd` accesses them at these *relative paths*:

- `../Exp1/Exp1_curvature/participant_cluster_lookup.csv`
- `../Exp1/Exp1_noInstr/participant_cluster_lookup.csv`
- `../Exp2/Exp2_curvature/participant_cluster_lookup.csv`
- `../Exp2/Exp2_noInstr/participant_cluster_lookup.csv`
- `../Exp3/Exp3_curvature/participant_cluster_lookup.csv`
- `../Exp3/Exp3_noInstr/participant_cluster_lookup.csv`

The relative paths are resolved from the `.Rmd` directory when knitting in RStudio. Both workbooks contain `exp1 curv`, `exp1 noInstr`, `exp2 curv`, `exp2 noInstr`, `exp3 curv`, and `exp3 noInstr` (case and spaces are normalized when matching). Some rows without participant IDs are continuation text, **not additional participants**.

# Setup and data import

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 5.8)
```


```{r}
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)

human_file <- "Curvature Open Answers.xlsx"
llm_file <- "Curvature_Open_Answers_LLM_coded_detailed.xlsx"

stopifnot(file.exists(human_file), file.exists(llm_file))
```

## Import all six study sheets 
```{r}
normalize_id <- function(x) {
  sub("\\.0+$", "", trimws(as.character(x)))
}

binary_code <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- NA_character_

  if (any(!is.na(x) & !(x %in% c("0", "1")))) {
    stop("A coding column contains a value other than 0, 1, or NA.")
  }

  as.integer(x)
}


# Resolve sheet names despite changes in case/spacing.
resolve_sheet <- function(file, requested, optional = FALSE) {
  available <- readxl::excel_sheets(file)
  norm <- function(x) gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", tolower(x))
  match <- which(norm(available) == norm(requested))
  if (length(match) == 1L) return(available[[match]])
  if (optional) {
    message("Skipping missing optional sheet '", requested, "' in ", basename(file))
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  stop("Missing Excel sheet '", requested, "' in ", basename(file),
       ". Available sheets: ", paste(available, collapse = ", "))
}

read_answers <- function(file, sheet, experiment, condition, coder, optional = FALSE) {
  sheet_found <- resolve_sheet(file, sheet, optional = optional)
  if (is.na(sheet_found)) {
    return(tibble(
      experiment = character(), condition = character(), coder = character(),
      subj_id = character(), answer = character(), smoothness = integer(),
      vertices = integer(), third_feature = integer(), intuition = integer(),
      globalness = integer(), animal_like = integer(), size = integer()
    ))
  }

  dat <- read_excel(file, sheet = sheet_found, col_types = "text")

  if (experiment %in% c("Exp 2", "Exp 3")) {

    # Experiments 2 and 3: 6 indicators (columns 3–8), plus size.
    dat <- dat[, 1:9]

    names(dat) <- c(
      "subj_id", "answer", "smoothness", "vertices",
      "third_feature", "intuition", "globalness", "animal_like", "size"
    )

  } else {

    # Exp1 has 5 indicators (columns 3–7)
    dat <- dat[, 1:8]

    names(dat) <- c(
      "subj_id", "answer", "smoothness", "vertices",
      "third_feature", "intuition", "globalness", "size"
    )

    dat$animal_like <- NA_character_
  }

  dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(subj_id), trimws(subj_id) != "") %>%
    mutate(
      subj_id = normalize_id(subj_id),
      across(c(smoothness:animal_like, size), binary_code),
      experiment = experiment,
      condition = condition,
      coder = coder,
      .before = 1
    )
}

# Human coding (Experiments 1, 2, and 3)
human <- bind_rows(
  read_answers(human_file, "exp1 curv",
               "Exp 1", "Curvature instruction", "Human"),
  read_answers(human_file, "exp1 noInstr",
               "Exp 1", "No instruction", "Human"),
  read_answers(human_file, "exp2 curv",
               "Exp 2", "Curvature instruction", "Human"),
  read_answers(human_file, "exp2 noInstr",
               "Exp 2", "No instruction", "Human"),
  read_answers(human_file, "exp3 curv",
               "Exp 3", "Curvature instruction", "Human"),
  read_answers(human_file, "exp3 noInstr",
               "Exp 3", "No instruction", "Human")
)

# LLM coding (Experiments 1, 2, and 3)
llm <- bind_rows(
  read_answers(llm_file, "exp1 curv",
               "Exp 1", "Curvature instruction", "LLM"),
  read_answers(llm_file, "exp1 noInstr",
               "Exp 1", "No instruction", "LLM"),
  read_answers(llm_file, "exp2 curv",
               "Exp 2", "Curvature instruction", "LLM"),
  read_answers(llm_file, "exp2 noInstr",
               "Exp 2", "No instruction", "LLM"),
  read_answers(llm_file, "exp3 curv",
               "Exp 3", "Curvature instruction", "LLM"),
  read_answers(llm_file, "exp3 noInstr",
               "Exp 3", "No instruction", "LLM")
)

answers <- bind_rows(human, llm)

# Check number of participants per group and coder
answers %>%
  count(experiment, condition, coder, name = "n_participants")
```

## Checking participant IDs
```{r}
# Check for duplicates
duplicates <- answers %>%
  count(experiment, condition, coder, subj_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

print(duplicates)
stopifnot(nrow(duplicates) == 0)

# Compare human vs LLM participant coverage across Experiments 1, 2, and 3.
keys <- c("experiment", "condition", "subj_id")

human_ids <- human %>% select(all_of(keys))
llm_ids <- llm %>% select(all_of(keys))

only_human <- anti_join(human_ids, llm_ids, by = keys)
only_llm <- anti_join(llm_ids, human_ids, by = keys)
print(only_human)
print(only_llm)
stopifnot(nrow(only_human) == 0, nrow(only_llm) == 0)
```

## import cluster info
```{r}
read_clusters <- function(file, experiment, condition, optional = FALSE) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    if (!optional) stop("Missing cluster CSV: ", file)
    message("Missing optional Experiment 3 cluster CSV: ", file,
            ". Skipping cluster-specific results for this group.")
    return(tibble(experiment = character(), condition = character(),
                  subj_id = character(), cluster = character()))
  }

  dat <- read_csv(
    file,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  if (!all(c("subj_id", "cluster") %in% names(dat))) {
    stop("Cluster CSV needs subj_id and cluster: ", file)
  }

  dat %>%
    transmute(
      experiment = experiment,
      condition = condition,
      subj_id = normalize_id(subj_id),
      cluster = trimws(as.character(cluster))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(subj_id), subj_id != "") %>%
    distinct()
}

cluster_lookup <- bind_rows(
  read_clusters(
    "../Exp1/Exp1_curvature/participant_cluster_lookup.csv",
    "Exp 1", "Curvature instruction"
  ),
  read_clusters(
    "../Exp1/Exp1_noInstr/participant_cluster_lookup.csv",
    "Exp 1", "No instruction"
  ),
  read_clusters(
    "../Exp2/Exp2_curvature/participant_cluster_lookup.csv",
    "Exp 2", "Curvature instruction"
  ),
  read_clusters(
    "../Exp2/Exp2_noInstr/participant_cluster_lookup.csv",
    "Exp 2", "No instruction"
  ),
  read_clusters(
    "../Exp3/Exp3_curvature/participant_cluster_lookup.csv",
    "Exp 3", "Curvature instruction"
  ),
  read_clusters(
    "../Exp3/Exp3_noInstr/participant_cluster_lookup.csv",
    "Exp 3", "No instruction"
  )
)

# Number of participants in each cluster
cluster_lookup %>%
  count(experiment, condition, cluster, name = "n_participants")

```
## Check and join the cluster assignments
```{r}
# Check for conflicting cluster assignments
cluster_duplicates <- cluster_lookup %>%
  count(experiment, condition, subj_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

print(cluster_duplicates)
stopifnot(nrow(cluster_duplicates) == 0)

# Check for missing cluster labels in the lookup
stopifnot(
  !any(is.na(cluster_lookup$cluster) | cluster_lookup$cluster == "")
)

# Identify participants without a cluster match
missing_clusters <- answers %>%
  distinct(experiment, condition, subj_id) %>%
  anti_join(cluster_lookup, by = keys)

print(missing_clusters)

# Join cluster assignments
answers_all <- answers %>%
  left_join(cluster_lookup, by = keys)

# Keep only participants with clusters for cluster-based analyses
answers_clustered <- answers_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster), cluster != "")

if (nrow(missing_clusters) > 0) {
  warning(
    nrow(missing_clusters),
    " participant(s) lack cluster assignments. Verify them in the main analysis."
  )
}

# Check final numbers by cluster
answers_clustered %>%
  distinct(experiment, condition, subj_id, cluster) %>%
  count(experiment, condition, cluster, name = "n_participants")
```

## Prepare the five features and check missing coding values
```{r}
answers_long_all <- answers_all %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      smoothness, vertices, third_feature,
      intuition, globalness, animal_like, size
    ),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "mentioned"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    feature = case_when(
      feature == "smoothness" ~ "Smoothness",
      feature == "vertices" ~ "Vertices",
      feature == "third_feature" & experiment == "Exp 1" ~ "Angle",
      feature == "third_feature" & experiment %in% c("Exp 2", "Exp 3") ~ "Range",
      feature == "intuition" ~ "Intuition",
      feature == "globalness" ~ "Globalness",
      feature == "animal_like" ~ "Animal-like",
      feature == "size" ~ "Size"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !(experiment == "Exp 1" & feature == "Animal-like")
  )

# Check missing indicator codes
missing_codes <- answers_long_all %>%
  group_by(experiment, condition, coder, feature) %>%
  summarise(
    n_missing = sum(is.na(mentioned)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_missing > 0)

print(missing_codes)

# Dataset for cluster analyses
answers_long <- answers_long_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster), cluster != "")
```

## Feature mention rates by cluster
```{r}
mention_rates <- answers_long %>%
  group_by(experiment, condition, coder, cluster, feature) %>%
  summarise(
    n_coded = sum(!is.na(mentioned)),
    n_mentioned = sum(mentioned == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = if_else(
      n_coded > 0,
      n_mentioned / n_coded,
      NA_real_
    ),
    percentage = 100 * proportion
  )

# 95% Wilson confidence intervals
z <- qnorm(0.975)

mention_rates <- mention_rates %>%
  mutate(
    denominator = 1 + z^2 / n_coded,
    center = (proportion + z^2 / (2 * n_coded)) / denominator,
    half_width = z * sqrt(
      proportion * (1 - proportion) / n_coded +
      z^2 / (4 * n_coded^2)
    ) / denominator,
    ci_lower = 100 * pmax(0, center - half_width),
    ci_upper = 100 * pmin(1, center + half_width)
  ) %>%
  select(-denominator, -center, -half_width)
```

```{r}
# Experiment 1, curvature instruction
mention_rates %>%
  filter(
    experiment == "Exp 1",
    condition == "Curvature instruction"
  ) %>%
  select(
    coder, cluster, feature,
    n_mentioned, n_coded, percentage
  ) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(percentage, 1)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print(row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)

# Consistent project colors
feature_cols <- c(
  "Smoothness" = "#F8766D",
  "Vertices" = "#00BA38",
  "Angle" = "#619CFF",
  "Range" = "#619CFF",
  "Intuition" = "#A78BFA",
  "Globalness" = "#B59B73",
  "Animal-like" = "#CC79A7",
  "Size" = "#E69F00"
)

plot_open_answers <- function(exp, cond) {

  dat <- mention_rates %>%
    filter(
      experiment == exp,
      condition == cond
    )

  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    message("No cluster-coded results for ", exp, " / ", cond,
            "; skipping this mention-rate chart.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  cluster_ns <- answers_clustered %>%
    filter(
      experiment == exp,
      condition == cond
    ) %>%
    distinct(subj_id, cluster) %>%
    count(cluster, name = "n_participants")

  # Set the correct features for each experiment
  feature_order <- if (exp == "Exp 1") {
    c("Smoothness", "Vertices", "Angle",
      "Intuition", "Globalness", "Size")
  } else {
    c("Smoothness", "Vertices", "Range",
      "Intuition", "Globalness", "Animal-like", "Size")
  }

  # Set cluster order
  clusters <- sort(unique(as.character(dat$cluster)))
  
  # Add n to cluster labels
  cluster_labels_df <- tibble(cluster = clusters) %>%
    left_join(cluster_ns, by = "cluster") %>%
    mutate(
      strip_label = paste0(cluster, " (n = ", n_participants, ")")
    )
  
  cluster_labels <- setNames(
    cluster_labels_df$strip_label,
    cluster_labels_df$cluster
  )
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      feature = factor(feature, levels = feature_order),
      cluster = factor(cluster, levels = clusters, labels = cluster_labels[clusters]),
      coder = factor(coder, levels = c("Human", "LLM"))
    )
  
  # Colored cluster headings
  cluster_colors <- ifelse(
    grepl("smooth", clusters, ignore.case = TRUE),
    "#F8766D", "#00BA38"
  )
  
  cluster_fills <- ifelse(
    grepl("smooth", clusters, ignore.case = TRUE),
    "#FDE8E6", "#E8F7EC"
  )
  cluster_strip <- ggh4x::strip_themed(
    background_x = ggh4x::elem_list_rect(
      fill = cluster_fills,
      colour = rep("black", length(clusters)),
      linewidth = rep(0.6, length(clusters))
    ),
    text_x = ggh4x::elem_list_text(
      colour = cluster_colors,
      face = rep("bold", length(clusters)),
      size = rep(12, length(clusters))
    )
  )

  # Figure
  ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(
      x = feature,
      y = percentage,
      fill = feature
    )
  ) +

    geom_col(
      width = 0.65,
      alpha = 0.65,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +

    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = ci_lower,
        ymax = ci_upper
      ),
      width = 0.15,
      linewidth = 0.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    ggh4x::facet_grid2(
      rows = vars(coder),
      cols = vars(cluster),
      strip = cluster_strip,
      axes = "x",
      remove_labels = "x"
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(values = feature_cols) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
      limits = c(0, 100),
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +

    labs(
      x = "Feature mentioned",
      y = "Participants mentioning feature (%)",
      title = paste(exp, "—", cond)
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 35,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 10
      ),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(12, "pt"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        color = "grey92",
        linewidth = 0.3
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 16,
        face = "bold"
      )
    )
}
```

# Word Frequencies and Word Clouds

This section reads `wordcloud_terms` and `wordcloud_features` directly from the coded LLM workbook (`Curvature_Open_Answers_LLM_coded_detailed.xlsx`) across all six experiment sheets (`exp1 curv`, `exp1 noInstr`, `exp2 curv`, `exp2 noInstr`, `exp3 curv`, `exp3 noInstr`) to generate:

1. **Overall word clouds for each experiment** (all extracted vocabulary in `wordcloud_terms` for Experiment 1, Experiment 2, and Experiment 3).
2. **Feature-specific word clouds for each experiment and feature** (using `wordcloud_features` to see which words are most mentioned for `smoothness`, `number of vertices`, and `angle` / `range`).

```{r word-frequency-tables}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggwordcloud)
library(readxl)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)

wordcloud_file <- llm_file

stopifnot(file.exists(wordcloud_file))

wc_sheet_specs <- tribble(
  ~sheet,         ~experiment, ~condition,
  "exp1 curv",    "Exp 1",     "Curvature instruction",
  "exp1 noInstr", "Exp 1",     "No instruction",
  "exp2 curv",    "Exp 2",     "Curvature instruction",
  "exp2 noInstr", "Exp 2",     "No instruction",
  "exp3 curv",    "Exp 3",     "Curvature instruction",
  "exp3 noInstr", "Exp 3",     "No instruction"
)

read_wordcloud_tokens <- function(file, sheet, experiment, condition) {
  sheet_found <- resolve_sheet(file, sheet, optional = TRUE)
  if (is.na(sheet_found)) return(tibble())

  dat <- read_excel(file, sheet = sheet_found, col_types = "text")
  if (!("wordcloud_terms" %in% names(dat))) {
    stop("Column 'wordcloud_terms' not found in sheet '", sheet_found, "' of ", file)
  }
  if (!("wordcloud_features" %in% names(dat))) {
    dat$wordcloud_features <- ""
  }

  dat <- dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(subj_id), trimws(subj_id) != "")

  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dat)), function(i) {
    raw_terms <- dat$wordcloud_terms[[i]]
    raw_feats <- dat$wordcloud_features[[i]]

    if (is.na(raw_terms) || trimws(raw_terms) == "") return(tibble())

    terms_vec <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(raw_terms), ";", fixed = TRUE)))
    terms_vec <- terms_vec[terms_vec != ""]
    if (length(terms_vec) == 0) return(tibble())

    feats_vec <- if (is.na(raw_feats) || trimws(raw_feats) == "") {
      character(0)
    } else {
      trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(raw_feats), ";", fixed = TRUE)))
    }

    # Categorized terms are ordered first in wordcloud_terms; pad trailing uncategorized slots with ""
    length(feats_vec) <- length(terms_vec)
    feats_vec[is.na(feats_vec)] <- ""

    tibble(
      experiment = experiment,
      condition = condition,
      subj_id = normalize_id(dat$subj_id[[i]]),
      term = terms_vec,
      feature = feats_vec
    )
  })
}

wc_tokens <- pmap_dfr(wc_sheet_specs, function(sheet, experiment, condition) {
  read_wordcloud_tokens(wordcloud_file, sheet, experiment, condition)
})

count_word_freq <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(term), term != "") %>%
    count(term, name = "frequency") %>%
    arrange(desc(frequency), term) %>%
    mutate(percentage = 100 * frequency / sum(frequency))
}

# 1. Overall word frequency tables for each experiment (all terms in wordcloud_terms)
exp1_overall_word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 1") %>%
  count_word_freq()

exp2_overall_word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 2") %>%
  count_word_freq()

exp3_overall_word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 3") %>%
  count_word_freq()

# 2. Feature-specific word frequency tables (using wordcloud_features)
# Exp 1: smoothness, number of vertices, angle
word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 1", feature == "smoothness") %>%
  count_word_freq()

vertices_word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 1", feature == "number of vertices") %>%
  count_word_freq()

angle_word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 1", feature == "angle") %>%
  count_word_freq()

# Exp 2: smoothness, number of vertices, range
exp2_smoothness_word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 2", feature == "smoothness") %>%
  count_word_freq()

exp2_vertices_word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 2", feature == "number of vertices") %>%
  count_word_freq()

exp2_range_word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 2", feature == "range") %>%
  count_word_freq()

# Exp 3: smoothness, number of vertices, range
exp3_smoothness_word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 3", feature == "smoothness") %>%
  count_word_freq()

exp3_vertices_word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 3", feature == "number of vertices") %>%
  count_word_freq()

exp3_range_word_freq <- wc_tokens %>%
  filter(experiment == "Exp 3", feature == "range") %>%
  count_word_freq()

# Inspect overall and feature-specific frequency tables
cat("=== OVERALL WORD FREQUENCIES BY EXPERIMENT ===\n")
print(exp1_overall_word_freq, n = 25)
print(exp2_overall_word_freq, n = 25)
print(exp3_overall_word_freq, n = 25)

cat("\n=== FEATURE-SPECIFIC WORD FREQUENCIES (EXP 1–3) ===\n")
print(word_freq, n = Inf)
print(vertices_word_freq, n = Inf)
print(angle_word_freq, n = Inf)
print(exp2_smoothness_word_freq, n = Inf)
print(exp2_vertices_word_freq, n = Inf)
print(exp2_range_word_freq, n = Inf)

print(exp3_range_word_freq, n = Inf)
```

## 1. Overall Word Clouds for Each Experiment (Experiments 1–3)

```{r plot-overall-wordclouds, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
dir.create(
  "open_answer_outputs/figures",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

plot_wordcloud <- function(dat, low, high, filename, shorten_number_of = FALSE, title = NULL) {
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    message("No terms found for ", filename, "; skipping plot.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(label = if (shorten_number_of) sub("^number of ", "", term) else term)

  set.seed(123)
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(label = label, size = frequency, color = frequency)) +
    ggwordcloud::geom_text_wordcloud_area(rm_outside = TRUE) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 60) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = low, high = high) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )

  if (!is.null(title)) {
    p <- p + labs(title = title)
  }

  print(p)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("open_answer_outputs", "figures", filename),
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
  invisible(p)
}

# Overall word clouds per experiment
p_exp1_overall_wordcloud <- plot_wordcloud(
  exp1_overall_word_freq, "#D1D5DB", "#1F2937",
  "exp1_overall_wordcloud.png",
  title = "Experiment 1 — Overall Mentioned Terms"
)

p_exp2_overall_wordcloud <- plot_wordcloud(
  exp2_overall_word_freq, "#D1D5DB", "#1F2937",
  "exp2_overall_wordcloud.png",
  title = "Experiment 2 — Overall Mentioned Terms"
)

p_exp3_overall_wordcloud <- plot_wordcloud(
  exp3_overall_word_freq, "#D1D5DB", "#1F2937",
  "exp3_overall_wordcloud.png",
  title = "Experiment 3 — Overall Mentioned Terms"
)
```
